name: Fable 5
notes: Most capable Anthropic model. Used as the strong labeler for ground truth.

name: Opus 4.8
notes: Flagship Opus tier.

name: Sonnet 4.6
notes: Current Anthropic default chat model (QM) in the app catalogue.

name: Sonnet 4.5
notes: Current Anthropic default cell (CUP) in the app catalogue.

name: Haiku 4.5
notes: Fastest and cheapest Anthropic model.

name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
notes: Newest Flash (2026-07). Same input rate as 3.5 Flash but cheaper output (7.50 vs 9).

name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
notes: Current Gemini default (both roles) in the app catalogue. Gemini caching is implicit — no separate write charge in usageMetadata.

name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
notes: Newest Flash-Lite (2026-07). Pricier than 3.1 Flash-Lite (0.25/1.50); audio input included at the same 0.30 rate.

name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
notes: Most capable Gemini (preview). Prices are the <=200k-prompt tier; >200k is 4/18.

name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
notes: Cheapest, fastest Gemini. Text/image/video input rate; audio input is 0.50.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
notes: Previous-gen Flash. Text/image/video input rate; audio input is 1.00.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
notes: Cheapest Gemini overall. Text/image/video input rate; audio input is 0.30.

name: GPT-5.5
notes: Current OpenAI default chat model (QM) in the app catalogue. Text+image input only; audio needs the gpt-realtime family.

name: GPT-5.4 Mini
notes: Current OpenAI default cell (CUP) in the app catalogue.

name: GPT-5.4
notes: Mid flagship — cheaper than 5.5, stronger than mini.

name: GPT-5.4 Nano
notes: Cheapest OpenAI cell candidate.

name: GPT-5.5 Pro
notes: Top reasoning tier. Reference only — served via the Responses API, not chat completions, so the app engine can't call it and it isn't swept.

name: GLM-4.7 (Cerebras)
notes: Z.ai's open-weight flagship served on Cerebras's free developer tier (prices are the free tier — $0). Bench-only provider; free-tier caps: 30 RPM, 14,400 RPD, ~1M tokens/day as of 2026-07. Lineup and limits change without notice — verify at inference-docs.cerebras.ai before relying on this row.

name: GPT-OSS 120B (Cerebras)
notes: OpenAI's open-weight 120B MoE served on Cerebras's free developer tier (prices are the free tier — $0); ~1,800-3,000 tok/s, the fastest host for this model. Same free-tier caps and verify-before-trusting caveat as zai-glm-4.7.

name: Qwen3 Coder (OpenRouter free)
notes: Strongest :free tool-calling/coding model in 2026-07 roundups, but its only host (Venice) was saturated for hours in the 2026-07-17 benchmark — zero calls succeeded; superseded as the free pick by cohere/north-mini-code:free. Free-plan caps: 20 req/min; ~50 req/day on a $0 account, 1,000/day after a one-time $10 credit purchase. :free endpoints 404 unless the account's privacy settings allow free model publication; the lineup rotates without notice — verify at openrouter.ai/models before relying on this row.

name: Llama 3.3 70B (OpenRouter free)
notes: Long-lived :free workhorse (fast, non-reasoning), but Venice-hosted like qwen3-coder and equally unreachable in the 2026-07-17 benchmark; superseded as the free pick by cohere/north-mini-code:free. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as qwen/qwen3-coder:free.

name: Hy3 (OpenRouter free)
notes: Tencent's 295B MoE (21B active) — reasoning modes, stable tool calling. FREE ROUTE ENDED 2026-07-21 — row kept at $0 to price the committed 2026-07-17 sweep; paid hy3 is 0.14/0.58 per Mtok. Same free-plan caps and privacy-settings requirement as the other :free rows.

name: Nemotron 3 Ultra (OpenRouter free)
notes: NVIDIA's 550B MoE (55B active) frontier agent model, 1M context, ~300 tok/s. No announced end date for the free route. Same free-plan caps and privacy-settings requirement as the other :free rows.

name: Laguna M.1 (OpenRouter free)
notes: Poolside's coding model, hosted by Poolside itself. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: Gemma 4 31B (OpenRouter free)
notes: Google's open-weights mid-size instruct model. Tool calls are clean when calls are spaced, but the :free route has a SINGLE host (Google AI Studio) whose shared free pool was 429 rate-limited upstream through the 2026-08-05 run (limit_source upstream_provider_shared_pool) — no scored rows obtained. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: Nemotron 3 Super (OpenRouter free)
notes: NVIDIA's 120B MoE (12B active), 1M context, hosted by Nvidia. Like nemotron-3-ultra, its reasoning output breaks the engine's JSON cell protocol (Invalid JSON response) and it is slow — the 2026-08-05 run could not complete a single scored config. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: North Mini Code (OpenRouter free)
notes: Cohere's compact coding model, hosted by Cohere — the app's OpenRouter provider default for both roles (96% at batch 5 in the 2026-07-17 benchmark; models.json pins batchSize 5). Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: GPT-OSS 120B (Groq)
notes: OpenAI's open-weight 120B MoE served by Groq — the app's Groq default chat model. Measured at $0.0004 and 3.1sec per 1000 tokens in the 2026-08-11 provider probe, the cheapest and fastest paid chat model in the catalogue. Groq's free developer tier caps this model at 8K TPM; the paid tier is far higher, and Groq publishes no API signal for which tier a key is on.

name: GPT-OSS 20B (Groq)
notes: The 20B sibling of gpt-oss-120b and the app's Groq default cell model — ~1,000 tok/s, measured at $0.0002 and 1.5sec per 1000 tokens in the 2026-08-11 provider probe.

name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
notes: Meta's long-lived instruct workhorse on Groq. Reachable but not swept — kept as a fallback candidate if the gpt-oss pair regresses.

name: Llama 3.1 8B (Groq)
notes: The cheapest row in the catalogue and the fastest small model on Groq. A cell-model candidate for the next batch-size sweep.

name: Gemini 3.6 Flash (OpenRouter)
notes: Google's 3.6 Flash proxied by OpenRouter at Google's own rate, verified against the live /models endpoint on 2026-08-13. The chat model of OpenRouter's paid set.

name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (OpenRouter)
notes: Google's 3.1 Flash-Lite proxied by OpenRouter at Google's own rate, verified 2026-08-13. The cell model of OpenRouter's paid set.
